A lyrics animation made in Tourne'Table's Animation editor.

about: one line about your animation

```ttlyrics
Paste the text of your .ttlyrics file here (Animation editor > Export..., then open it in Notepad).
```

If it carries CSS (Paste keyframes), keep its "# css source:" line with where it came from and its licence; CSS from Animate.css can't be shared here. Scripts and anything that reaches online (url(), @import) are taken out.

By sharing, you let people use and change your animation under [CC BY-NC-SA 4.0](../../LICENSE-CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0.txt): with credit to you, not for sale, and shared the same way. It stays yours.
